description: Search SEC EDGAR filings by keyword/form/date, browse IPO registrations, or fetch filings and XBRL financial facts for a company. No cookies or API key required.

cikOrTicker.description: Stock ticker (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL) or SEC CIK (0000320193). Required for getCompanyFilings and getCompanyFacts; optional company filter for searchFilings and browseIPOs.
cikOrTicker.title: Company CIK or ticker

dateEnd.description: Only include filings filed on or before this date. Applies to searchFilings, browseIPOs and getCompanyFilings.
dateEnd.title: Date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateStart.description: Only include filings filed on or after this date. Applies to searchFilings, browseIPOs and getCompanyFilings.
dateStart.title: Date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

factTaxonomy.description: For getCompanyFacts, choose which XBRL taxonomy to return.
factTaxonomy.title: XBRL taxonomy

formType.description: SEC form type filter for searchFilings and getCompanyFilings. browseIPOs always uses S-1 (plus S-1/A when Include amendments is on).
formType.title: Form type

includeAmendments.description: For browseIPOs, also include S-1/A amendment filings alongside new S-1 registrations.
includeAmendments.title: Include amendments

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return. SEC full-text search caps at 10,000 results.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to fetch from SEC EDGAR.
enumTitles: Search filings (keyword + form type + date + optional company)
Get company filings (by ticker or CIK)
mode.title: Mode

query.description: Full-text search query for mode=searchFilings. Supports phrases in quotes. Examples: "artificial intelligence", "going concern", "material weakness", "IPO".
query.title: Search query

title: SEC EDGAR IPO & XBRL Financial Facts Scraper Input
